name: Swole Blessings
source: Kamila is all alone. Her sisters, worshippers of the goddess Swoleth, have perished at the hands of the fanatical followers of the god Lolomuth. Now, she must fight her way forward to survive and avenge her fellow worshippers. Along the way, she will meet new people who will help her achieve her goal. Will she gain enough power to accomplish her objective?
